<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:2">Ab. III, 2</cite> <he>נוח לת׳</he>, v. <cite ref="N00343"><he>נוֹחַ</he> II</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:2:2">Y. Taan. II, 65ᵇ</cite> bot. (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:26">Lam. R. to I, 2</cite> <he>היה לה בן ת׳ ומת</he> she had a grown up son, and he died; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:11">ib. II, 11</cite>.

senses.gloss: (sub. מיתת) death at manhood, premature death. Ib. של ת׳ (דמעה) tears over the loss of a grown up child. Treat. Der. Er. Zutta ch. IX כרי שתנצל ממלאך הת׳ in order that thou mayest be saved from the angel of premature death.—[
search for young men, conscription. Tanna d’be Elijahu ch. I.]
